result_summary: Completed the scoped Alumnos / página docente UX-flow audit without redesign or authority promotion. The dominant friction is authority-aware target resolution: `alumnos-teacher` is currently a coordination target, not one authoritative physical teacher page, while the catalog-live José Study source and the later V11 LAB frontier have different visibility/authority semantics. A one-message teacher correction must therefore resolve the exact owned surface and authority state before writing, preserve learner-state/shared-owner boundaries, and return a visible-result receipt rather than mutating whichever artifact appears newest.
material_advances: Reconstructed the teacher-to-student correction roundtrip across project/root identity, concrete child surfaces, product authority and learner state instead of assuming one Alumnos page.

Identified HIGH target ambiguity: a request such as 'Cambiá la página de José' can legitimately refer to the catalog-live José Study source, the V11 LAB frontier, Student World, a subject/course page or a Class Player capability surface.
Identified HIGH latest-vs-visible divergence: V11 is the later durable design frontier but remains NOT_CURRENT_NOT_SERVED, while the catalog declares the separate José Study route live.

Inspected the current José Study source and found learner state persisted in localStorage plus direct consumption of shared Study v1; this audit found no in-page teacher/contenteditable/network correction channel in that source.
Separated durable content/design authority from browser-local learner interaction state so future content corrections do not implicitly erase attempts/progress.
Preserved shared/study/current.json as the reusable Study UI owner and PageKit/Class Player as selective capability evidence rather than a replacement teacher shell.

Specified a one-message correction contract: resolve root/child/authority/owner, perform CAS-scoped candidate work and validation, preserve state boundaries, then return exact target + visible/candidate status + reopenable receipt.
Deduplicated implementation work against the already-claimed Page Thread Bridge and the sibling Alumnos truth/intent/reuse/risk/discover/plan/local-integration lanes; emitted no redundant proposal.
non_obvious_findings: The key UX defect is an authority-resolution defect: newest design and student-visible target are not necessarily the same artifact.
The swarm label alumnos-teacher is a coordination identifier, not evidence that a singular teacher product/page already exists.

The safest correction UX is not an ad-hoc admin mode embedded in the student app; it is a page-thread/control-plane bridge that resolves ownership and returns visible-result receipts while keeping the learner surface simple.
preserved_invariants: José Study four Algebra topics remain distinct, each with a topic-local 12-level map; the 48 canonical exercises remain sourced rather than reinvented.
Theory scrolling must not silently destroy or mutate current practice state.
Selection remains distinct from submission and diagnostic traps remain hidden before submission.
Mobile theory/practice flow and desktop wheel/trackpad + drag parity remain guardrails.
shared/study/current.json remains the reusable Study UI owner; student-specific continuation must not fork it.
Student World, subject, Study, Class/Atlas and homework remain distinct identities.
V11 is not promoted from LAB by recency; V37 is not promoted over V26 by version number.
Current, Human Accepted and Served remain separate authority gates.
/wc remains canary and no production /w promotion was performed.

next_safe_frontier.when: only after its sibling Alumnos lens returns and required local-steward/page-thread prerequisites are durably satisfied
next_safe_frontier.instruction: Consume this audit as UX evidence. Resolve exact target and authority before writes; preserve learner-state and shared Study ownership; do not invent a singular Alumnos teacher page from the coordination label.

source_freshness_at_return.note: The broad canary continued advancing main while this scoped run executed; runtime publication lagged live main. Exact file/blob refs and isolated own-scope CAS writes anchor this return.

authority_boundary: Scoped UX audit and own durable metadata only. No Alumnos root binding, product source, learner state, shared Study owner, Catalog, Current, Lineage, Human Accepted or Served authority was changed.
